name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv-allprior
notes: Controlled twin of run-hstar-cv-postcovid.json. Identical in every respect except one: the scan node is not wired to splits.train_start_ms, so training is all-prior back to the 2016-01-01 tape start instead of the declared 730 days. Same 20 folds, same two names, same estimator, same seed. The paired difference in per-fold validation IC is therefore attributable to the training window alone. This deliberately readmits COVID and the unadjusted AAPL 2020-08-31 split into the training set of every fold; the question it answers is whether that extra history helps.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label. One tree, five H's. Short HPO lives on the scan node, not universe.scan.

alpaca.notes: Historical SIP tape. root is the invoking cwd; run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale already in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session.

features.notes: No raw lags. Keep the 46 (5 scales × 5 moments, calendar, SPY residual, industry) plus mom on those scales and ret/rv/mom at 3m/2h/3h/2s/1w (20 extra → 66). ret_lag_0 stays internal for the SPY residual. Action lookback stays 30.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals. One tree; each name still walks its own H.

pair.notes: Two names only. Rows are per-symbol frames, so this drops whole frames the way keep-symbols does. Sits after tradable so the cohort that built the features is untouched.

scan.notes: One LightGBM over the two kept names; last column is the symbol category. train_start_ms is deliberately NOT wired, so the node trains all-prior and the declared walkforward.train_days is inert. This is the control arm, not a recommended configuration.

walkforward.notes: Same 20 folds as the post-COVID run so the two are paired fold for fold. Validation windows never touch COVID; training windows now do, because there is no left bound. n_train should grow by roughly one validation period per fold rather than holding near 42,000.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
